category_attributes_minmax_number_only.name: category_attributes_minmax_number_only
category_attributes_minmax_number_only.value: "category_attributes"."type" = 'number' OR ("category_attributes"."min_value" IS NULL AND "category_attributes"."max_value" IS NULL)

ledger_entries_sign.name: ledger_entries_sign
ledger_entries_sign.value:
CASE "ledger_entries"."type"
            WHEN 'sale' THEN "ledger_entries"."amount_cents" > 0
            WHEN 'commission_reversal' THEN "ledger_entries"."amount_cents" >= 0
            WHEN 'commission' THEN "ledger_entries"."amount_cents" <= 0
            WHEN 'sale_reversal' THEN "ledger_entries"."amount_cents" < 0
            WHEN 'payout' THEN "ledger_entries"."amount_cents" < 0
            ELSE "ledger_entries"."amount_cents" <> 0 END

order_payments_recorded.name: order_payments_recorded
order_payments_recorded.value: "order_payments"."recorded_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "order_payments"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL
